sloka: मत्सन्देशयुता वाचस्त्वत्तः श्रुत्वैव राघवः ।पराक्रमविधिं वीरो विधिवत् संविधास्यति ।। ५.३९.१२।।।।
transliteration: matsandeśayutā vācastvattaḥ śrutvaiva rāghavaḥ ।parākramavidhiṁ vīro vidhivat saṁvidhāsyati ।। 5.39.12।।।।

translations.english: After hearing my message repeated from you, the heroic Rama will duly make his display of valour.
